issues.description: The problem statement requires listing the names of Gemeinden in Oberbayern OR Niederbayern that have a Wanderweg (logical OR). The solution implementation for aufgabe05.sql uses an AND between the two regierungsbezirk comparisons: (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Oberbayern' AND Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Niederbayern'), which can never be true and therefore contradicts the problem requirement. This makes the provided solution incorrect and will confuse students who compare their queries to the reference solution.
issues.suggested_fix: In the solution (and any provided example), change the conjunction to a disjunction so the condition matches the task: AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Oberbayern' OR Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Niederbayern'). Ensure parentheses group the OR correctly.
